setting.name: CombinatoricsReader_fileLocationPath

setting.name: console.output.isPrintPretty
setting.reason: Console colouring and log aggregation of the legacy processes. This build writes its machine-readable report to standard output and diagnostics to standard error (decision F30).

setting.name: core.counter4copyMax
setting.reason: Batch size of PostgreSQL COPY statements. The legacy framework kept its intermediate and final tables in PostgreSQL; this build keeps run state on the heap and has no database (architecture R03).

setting.name: core.distinctify.javaSide
setting.reason: Where de-duplication ran (SQL or JVM). This build de-duplicates in the JVM when the distinctify flags ask for it; the flags carry the semantics.

setting.name: core.distinctify.sampleAndSkip
setting.reason: Skipped de-duplication when a TABLESAMPLE probe saw no duplicates: an approximate shortcut of the SQL implementation. This build de-duplicates exactly whenever the distinctify flags ask for it.

setting.name: core.input.dumpJsonAuto
setting.reason: Dumped the parsed schedule as JSON beside the input. The embedding API writes any scenario as JSON, YAML, TOML or XLSX (fw-input WorkbookWriter); no file is written during a run.

setting.name: core.input.dumpJsonPath
setting.reason: Dumped the parsed schedule as JSON beside the input. The embedding API writes any scenario as JSON, YAML, TOML or XLSX (fw-input WorkbookWriter); no file is written during a run.

setting.name: core.input.format

setting.name: core.intermediate.storage
setting.reason: Where intermediate tables lived (postgres or memory). This build always keeps them on the heap; the rows are the same.

setting.name: core.keys.anchorSheet
setting.reason: Read only by the anchor and optimal relabelling strategies, which core.keys.strategy refuses.

setting.name: core.keys.audit
setting.reason: Installed a database-side key guard and audited the tables of the experimental byte tier. This build validates every key in its codecs, always.

setting.name: core.keys.dispatch
setting.reason: Key width: short (default) is two octets per key (PACKED_LEGACY16), auto lets one octet suffice when every label fits (AUTO_PRESERVE). Labels are numbered identically either way (byte-migration B06); only the storage width differs.

setting.name: core.keys.minGainPercent
setting.reason: Read only by the anchor and optimal relabelling strategies, which core.keys.strategy refuses.

setting.name: core.keys.scope
setting.reason: What the 16-bit tier counted against its 65535 labels, read with parseEnum (blank or absent: all): all counted data sheets, values and virtual sheets, cells only values. Becomes cf.keys.window.scope, which the legacy-window mode applies.

setting.name: core.keys.strategy
setting.reason: Label placement, read with parseEnum (blank or absent: identity). identity kept the legacy numbering S+1..S+C while it fit the 16-bit tier and otherwise moved the labels to the cheapest window (DataTypeDispatcher.uniformBestBase): exactly cf.keys.logical.labels=legacy-window (decision F2, M03), which an imported configuration also reproduces when it leaves the key out. The experimental byte tier (core.keys.dispatch=auto) had its own window, which is not reproduced; labels follow the 16-bit tier. anchor and optimal relabel the keys, which needs its own parity evidence and is refused.

setting.name: core.limitVarGivenLessThan
setting.reason: Cut-off of the final Cartesian product (FinalTableAssembler.computeLimitVar): the first rows of the product were written, as many as the product of the trailing sheets' largest combination ids that stayed at or below this value; each optional combination's product was capped the same way. Read with Long.parseLong and validated 1..Long.MAX_VALUE. Becomes cf.assembly.mandatoryLimit.

setting.name: core.threading.parallelizeSubCombosIfPossible
setting.reason: Chose the generator library of the first and the ungrouped later passes, and with it the row order, read with Boolean.parseBoolean(getProperty(key, "false")): true (set by each of the four shipped Core configurations; the two Reader configurations and the byte-keys overlay appended to fw.properties do not set it) chose the parallel library (lexicographic permutations, last position fastest in permutations with repetition), becoming cf.generation.library=PARALLEL; false, any other text or an absent key chose combinatoricslib3 3.3.3 (adjacent-swap permutations, first position fastest, other empty-input results), becoming COMBINATORICSLIB3. An imported configuration that leaves it out reproduces the legacy false (decision G6). Grouped passes and the FW_Permut duplicate marker kept their own generators either way.

setting.name: fw.analyzer.cacheCapacity
setting.reason: Memoised the analyzer executor's output per candidate line (capacity 4096). This build executes every sample and reuses compiled bytecode only (cf.compiler.cache.maxBytes): reusing a measurement would hide repeats and noise (audit AN-08).

setting.name: fw.analyzer.compileTmpExtension
setting.reason: Command-line templates with which the analyzer compiled and ran candidates as external programs; this build launches no process (architecture R02).

setting.name: fw.analyzer.coverage

setting.name: fw.analyzer.coverageReport
setting.reason: Report path template of the coverage probes, which this build refuses.

setting.name: fw.analyzer.enabled

setting.name: fw.analyzer.executorTimeoutSeconds

setting.name: fw.analyzer.executorType
setting.reason: How the analyzer evaluated candidates: shell, compile-and-run and remote ran external processes or polled a database of another process, which this build refuses.
setting.value: the row itself carried the metrics: the analysis reads typed observations, and the built-in SUT plugin inline-metrics turns a candidate's own key=value tokens into its observation

setting.name: fw.analyzer.goals

setting.name: fw.analyzer.maximizeKeys

setting.name: fw.analyzer.minimizeKeys

setting.name: fw.analyzer.seedOutputPath
setting.reason: Where the Analyzer wrote the BundleSeed (schema 1) of a run at its end; empty for none. Written atomically here, with the winners' sheet selections; a failed write is reported apart from the results (RESULT_EXPORT_FAILED), where the legacy shutdown hook printed it and carried on.

setting.name: fw.analyzer.seedSourceRunId
setting.reason: Named the run inside the seed (sourceRunId, default reader-<epoch ms>). A seed carries the id of the run that wrote it, cf.run.id.

setting.name: fw.analyzer.topK
setting.reason: Rows the analyzer snapshot kept by score (Integer.parseInt, default 20; below 1 read as 1).

setting.name: fw.controlplane.budgetMillis
setting.reason: Time budget of the legacy control plane in milliseconds (default 0: none; below 0 read as 0): a deadline after which unfinished work was cancelled cooperatively (cf.run.budget.millis).

setting.name: fw.controlplane.envs
setting.reason: Executor hosts the control plane spread samples over, for between-host variance; this build runs in one JVM on one host. Its environments (cf.execution.environments) are labels the system under test receives, all executed here, so a host list is refused rather than turned into labels.

setting.name: fw.controlplane.maxInFlight
setting.reason: Work units of the legacy control plane in flight at once (default 64, below 1 raised to 1). Samples executing at the same time are cf.execution.workers here (at most 1024).

setting.name: fw.controlplane.metricSensitivity
setting.reason: Metric type deciding per-host serialisation when fw.controlplane.serializePerHost is absent: noisy, perf, latency, throughput and continuous serialise; deterministic, verdict, fw_var and blank fan out; other text was refused.

setting.name: fw.controlplane.policy
setting.reason: Repeat policy of the legacy control plane (local, disperse, nested; blank is local, other text was refused; it wins over fw.executor.repeatPolicy): how the K repeats of a candidate are spread over the environments.

setting.name: fw.controlplane.repeatK
setting.reason: Repeats K of every candidate (legacy control plane; when both are set it wins over fw.executor.repeatEachCandidate, as first() read it).

setting.name: fw.controlplane.serializePerHost
setting.reason: One sample at a time per host, for metrics that concurrent samples disturb (explicit value wins over fw.controlplane.metricSensitivity). Every environment of this build shares one host, so it serialises every sample (cf.execution.serialize).

setting.name: fw.executor.repeatEachCandidate
setting.reason: Older name of fw.controlplane.repeatK; read only when fw.controlplane.repeatK is absent.

setting.name: fw.executor.repeatPolicy
setting.reason: Older name of fw.controlplane.policy; read only when fw.controlplane.policy is absent.

setting.name: reader.generalTimeoutToStop

setting.name: reader.in.jarFilesFromPath
